profile.hospital: Naval Hospital / Regional Military Medical Center

tricare_grace.details: Under TRICARE policy, a newborn is covered as TRICARE Prime/Select for the first 90 days from birth. By Day 90, formal DEERS and TRICARE enrollment must be finalized to prevent retroactive Point of Service cost-shares.

rapids_appointment.location: JBLM Waller Hall RAPIDS ID & DEERS Center

module_a.title: Hospital & T-0 to T+72 Hours (Immediate Sortie)

tasks.title: Hospital Administration Intake & Paternity Verification
tasks.sla: Within 24 hours of delivery
checklists: Mother full legal name & SSN verified
Father/Sponsor full legal name, rank, SSN/DoD ID verified
Infant official given name 'Aiden James Vane' spelled correctly
Hospital birth clerk signed and filed with State Dept of Health
tasks.notes: Automated test suite verification note.

tasks.title: Social Security Card Request Form Tracking (Form SS-5)
tasks.sla: 2-4 weeks delivery from SSA
forms: Form SS-5 (Application for a Social Security Card)
checklists: Hospital Electronic Birth Registration SSN request box checked 'YES'
SSA birth hospital intake receipt code retained in records
Verify physical mailing address matches home residence (not PO Box if restricted)
Track physical card arrival in secure mailbox
tasks.notes: Hospital birth registrar submitted SS-5 electronic feed. Card issued and received.

tasks.title: Certified Birth Certificate Order Tracker (5-8 Official Copies)
tasks.sla: 5-10 business days processing
copy_allocation: Copy 1: DEERS & military sponsor dependent enrollment (original inspected)
Copy 2: U.S. Passport Agency (Form DS-11 original submission)
Copy 3: 529 & Custodial UTMA/UGMA Banking / Wealth Architecture
Copy 4: Defense Enrollment / Tricare Backup & Medical Records
Copy 5: Future School / Daycare / Defense Dependent School registration
Copy 6: Master Family Safe / Hardened Lockbox Archive
checklists: Order 6 certified copies with raised state seal via VitalChek / County Health Dept
Pay certified vital record issuance fee ($25/ea + state surcharge)
Request expedited courier shipping with tracking number
Log receipt & verify raised embossed seal upon delivery
tasks.notes: Ordered 6 certified copies via State Vital Records. Tracking pending courier dispatch.

tasks.title: Newborn Metabolic Screening Card (Heel Prick Test)
tasks.sla: Sample collected prior to hospital discharge
forms: State Newborn Screening Specimen Card (Filter Paper Blood Specimen)
checklists: Heel prick blood spot card collected at 24-48 hours of life
Specimen laboratory tracking number documented in infant chart
Screening results routed to primary care pediatrician
Clearance for metabolic disorders, PKU, congenital hypothyroidism, sickle cell
tasks.notes: Blood spot card collected at 36 hours. Lab report confirmed negative/nominal.

tasks.title: Newborn Hearing Screening Clearance (OAE & AABR)
tasks.sla: Both ears tested prior to discharge
forms: Hospital Hearing Screening Certificate of Clearance
checklists: Otoacoustic Emissions (OAE) or Automated ABR conducted in nursery
Bilateral pass confirmation in mother/infant medical folder
Copy placed in pediatric follow-up packet
tasks.notes: Bilateral pass recorded. Normal acoustic response verified.

tasks.title: Hospital Discharge Summary Packet & Signed Physician Summary
tasks.sla: Obtained at bedside prior to discharge
checklists: Mother discharge vitals and physician signed release in hand
Infant discharge weight, length, head circumference documented
Hospital nursery discharge nurse sign-off on feeding & voiding schedule
Copy of itemized UB-04 / CMS-1500 hospital bills requested for insurance verification
tasks.notes: Discharge packet secured in physical binder. Initial pediatric appointment booked.

tasks.title: TRICARE 90-Day Newborn Grace Window Initialization
tasks.sla: 90 calendar days from Date of Birth
checklists: Verify infant is covered under sponsor's Prime policy for first 90 days
Ensure pediatrician bills claims under sponsor's SSN/DoD ID with infant as dependent
Set calendar alerts at T+30, T+60, and T+75 days to enforce DEERS enrollment
Prevent accidental lapse into TRICARE Select Point-of-Service deductible
tasks.notes: Grace window active. Currently at day T+0. Hard deadline: 2027-02-13.

module_b.title: Military Personnel & Administrative (T+3 to T+60 Days)

tasks.title: DEERS Enrollment & RAPIDS Appointment Engine
tasks.sla: Complete within 30 days of birth
forms: DD Form 1172-2 (Application for Identification Card/DEERS Enrollment)
checklists: Prerequisite: Certified State Birth Certificate with raised seal in hand
Prerequisite: Social Security Card or official SSA receipt
Sponsor & Spouse original government IDs (CAC / Military ID / Driver's License)
Marriage certificate (if not already verified in DEERS)
Execute DD Form 1172-2 signed by sponsor (or digitally pre-signed in ID Card Office Online)
Special POA in hand if sponsor is deployed/field training
Attend scheduled RAPIDS appointment at Waller Hall
tasks.notes: Appointment locked for 2026-12-05 10:00. Waiting on physical certified birth certificate.

tasks.title: TRICARE Prime Selection & Primary Care Manager (PCM) Assignment
tasks.sla: Must complete before Day 90 grace expires
checklists: Log in to milConnect Beneficiary Web Enrollment (BWE) 24h post-DEERS sync
Select TRICARE Prime option (no enrollment fee for active duty dependents)
Select PCM: Madigan AMC Pediatric Clinic / Dr. Sarah Vance
Confirm TRICARE enrollment letter generated and saved to records
Update clinic front desk with Aiden's dedicated DoD ID number
tasks.notes: Action triggers immediately once DEERS enrollment completes.

tasks.title: SGLI / FSGLI Automatic Coverage Verification ($10,000 at Birth)
tasks.sla: Automatic under federal law (38 U.S.C. 1967)
checklists: Verify Family Servicemembers' Group Life Insurance (FSGLI) child coverage is active ($10,000 coverage automatic at zero cost to member)
Access milConnect > Life Insurance > SOES to view beneficiary ledger
Verify Aiden is listed as child dependent under sponsor's SGLI tree
tasks.notes: Automatic $10,000 FSGLI coverage verified via milConnect. Zero monthly premium.

tasks.title: DD Form 93 (Record of Emergency Data) & iPERMS Execution
tasks.sla: Required within 30 days of dependent addition
checklists: Initiate updated DD Form 93 in IPPS-A / S1 personnel portal
Add Aiden James Vane as primary family dependent and child beneficiary
Update unpaid pay and allowances allocation percentages
Digitally sign via CAC and confirm auto-ingestion into iPERMS repository
tasks.notes: Draft DD-93 initiated in IPPS-A. Routing for signature once SSN card received.

tasks.title: IPPS-A Dependent Profile Verification & BAH Rate Audit
tasks.sla: Verify on following month's LES via myPay
forms: DA Form 5960 (Authorization to Start, Stop, or Change BAH)
checklists: Verify BAH with Dependents status reflects on active duty LES
Audit dependent list in IPPS-A to ensure birth date and dependent code match
Cross-verify with S1 PAC clerk for local housing allowance audit compliance
tasks.notes: Sponsor already receives BAH with Dependents (married). Verification required in IPPS-A tree.

module_c.title: Civil & Identity Hardening (T+14 to T+90 Days)

tasks.title: Passport Pipeline: Form DS-11 (Tourist Blue-Book & No-Fee)
tasks.sla: 4-6 weeks routine / 2-3 weeks expedited
forms: Form DS-11 (Application for a U.S. Passport)
checklists: Complete DS-11 online using State Dept Form Filler (do NOT sign until in front of agent)
Original State Certified Birth Certificate (submitted with application, mailed back later)
Both parents' valid government-issued photo IDs (Driver's license, CAC, passport) + front/back photocopies
One 2x2 inch infant compliant color photograph
Check or money order payable to 'U.S. Department of State' ($100 book fee + $35 execution fee)
Book in-person appointment at USPS Passport Acceptance Facility or County Clerk
tasks.notes: DS-11 pre-filled. Booking appointment window for late December once birth certificate arrives.

tasks.title: Infant Passport Photo Compliance Verification
tasks.sla: Must meet strict State Dept 2x2 photo specs
forms: State Dept Infant Photo Compliance Guide
checklists: Backdrop: Plain white or off-white sheet with ZERO shadows or textures
Positioning: Lay infant flat on back on white sheet, camera shot from directly above
Expression: Eyes open looking toward camera, neutral mouth (gentle smiles permitted)
Zero Hands: No parent hands, fingers, props, pacifiers, hats, or headbands visible in frame
Dimensions: 2x2 inches (51x51 mm) with head height between 1 inch and 1 3/8 inches (25-35 mm)
Print on glossy or matte photo-quality paper at local print shop or CVS/Walgreens
tasks.notes: Compliance guide reviewed. Photo shoot planned for home lighting setup.

tasks.title: Notarized Form DS-3053 (Statement of Consent: Minor Passport)
tasks.sla: Executed within 90 days of application submission
forms: Form DS-3053 (Statement of Consent - Minor Under Age 16)
checklists: Required ONLY if one parent cannot appear in person at passport acceptance facility
Non-applying parent completes DS-3053 in black ink
Form signed and dated in physical presence of a licensed Notary Public
Clear front and back photocopy of non-applying parent's government ID attached
Must be submitted within 90 calendar days of notarization date
tasks.notes: Standby contingency if sponsor is on duty. Both parents currently available to attend together.

tasks.title: Nationwide Credit Bureau Child File Freeze - Equifax
tasks.sla: Processed within 3 business days of receipt
forms: Equifax Minor Credit Freeze Request Packet
checklists: Draft formal written request for minor credit freeze under Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA)
Include photocopy of minor certified birth certificate
Include photocopy of minor Social Security Card
Include photocopy of parent/guardian Driver's License and utility bill for address proof
Send via USPS Certified Mail with Return Receipt to: Equifax Information Services LLC, P.O. Box 105788, Atlanta, GA 30348
Log confirmation PIN / receipt in vault
tasks.notes: Prevents synthetic identity theft and unauthorized credit lines. Packet compiled.

tasks.title: Nationwide Credit Bureau Child File Freeze - Experian
tasks.sla: Processed within 3 business days of receipt
forms: Experian Minor Status Freeze Request Form
checklists: Complete Experian Minor Child Security Freeze Form
Attach copy of child's birth certificate & SSN card
Attach copy of parent's driver's license & proof of address
Send via Certified Mail to: Experian, P.O. Box 9554, Allen, TX 75013
Confirm freeze creation acknowledgement letter
tasks.notes: Packet compiled for mailing alongside Equifax.

tasks.title: Nationwide Credit Bureau Child File Freeze - TransUnion
tasks.sla: Processed within 3 business days of receipt
checklists: Complete TransUnion Child Identity Protection Form
Enclose birth certificate copy, SSN card copy, and parent identification
Mail to: TransUnion, P.O. Box 160, Woodlyn, PA 19094
Verify complete freeze confirmation
tasks.notes: Completes triad of major national credit bureau file freezes.

tasks.title: ChexSystems Minor Consumer File Block
tasks.sla: Processed within 5 business days
checklists: Blocks fraudulent opening of checking or deposit accounts in minor's name
Submit online or mail form with proof of parentage (Birth Cert + SSN)
Retain confirmation certificate
tasks.notes: Blocks deposit account fraud across all U.S. financial institutions.

tasks.title: IRS Child Tax Credit (CTC) & W-4 Withholding Adjustment via myPay
tasks.sla: Processed on following monthly pay cycle
checklists: Log in to DFAS myPay portal > 'Federal Withholding' section
Update Step 3: Claim Dependents ($2,000 Child Tax Credit under age 17)
Evaluate monthly net paycheck increase vs annual tax refund preference
Verify updated withholding calculation on forthcoming LES
tasks.notes: W-4 estimator run. Ready to submit via myPay once SSN officially issued.

tasks.title: Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account (DCFSA) QLE Enrollment
tasks.sla: Must enroll within 60 calendar days of birth QLE
forms: FSAFEDS Qualifying Life Event (QLE) Enrollment Form
checklists: Qualifying Life Event: Birth of a child triggers 60-day special enrollment window
Enroll via FSAFEDS up to statutory maximum ($5,000/year pre-tax for dependent care/daycare)
Upload birth documentation or hospital proof within 30 days of application
Calculate effective payroll deduction spread across remaining pay periods
tasks.notes: 60-day clock active. Eligible for up to $5k pre-tax childcare savings.

Second series boosters for DTaP, Polio, Hib, Pneumococcal, and Rotavirus.
